what: promote the DAMNING EOA-admin-on-upgradeable governance fact from info/context to `bounding` the contract screen
direction: CONSERVATIVE — degrade-only: an EOA admin CAPS the contract screen at CAUTION (or lower), it NEVER lifts a verdict. The tool may honestly frighten, it may never automatically comfort. A net-generous promotion is presumptively wrong and HALTS.
scope: the DAMNING EOA-admin case ONLY (a single externally-owned key — direct or one owner-hop out — can replace an upgradeable pool's logic). SAFE / TIMELOCK / UNRESOLVED do NOT promote: gated is reassurance-with-homework (not a lift), unresolved stays context (never a guessed cap).

ZERO frozen-byte edits — a render-layer cap in the MinTRL/lineage-wall pattern, gated on the Operator's D29 signature.

affectedPoolCensus.rule: pre-computed so the Operator signs with EYES OPEN — exactly which current shelf subjects would be capped at CAUTION under the promotion.
affectedPoolCensus.note: 0 of the current shelf subjects hold an EOA admin (the governance census: 0 EOA / 1 TIMELOCK / 4 UNRESOLVED). Signing D29 today caps ZERO current verdicts — it ARMS the tool so the FIRST EOA-admin subject that enters the shelf is capped at CAUTION automatically. The promotion is a future-facing safety, not a present re-scoring (the curated shelf is already free of the damning class — which is itself the census's point: EOA-admin pools do not survive to be curated).

why: 'Admin = EOA on an upgradeable pool' predicts most stable-pool disasters — verdict-grade information, which is exactly why its promotion is Operator-gated and conservative. An agent must not move what decides verdicts (the D27 precedent). Until signed, the governance fact renders info/context and the verdict-path hashes are asserted UNCHANGED at every gate.
